notes: release 26H1128V2.1: the left icon rail now caps its content at 46 pct of the rail height, so the bottom half stays empty (480dpi landscape: content ends at 457 of 1008 px, 54.7 pct blank; 560dpi: 451 of 996 px); captions drop to icon-only and the glyph grows when the column is too short. Secondary screens no longer get clipped: an AlertDialog measures its wrap_content window against an unbounded height, so the ScrollView inside wrapped to full content and the window ran off screen with no way to scroll. ui/FitScrollView caps its measured height to a share of the screen and Dialogs.builder now overrides setView with a FitBuilder, so every dialog and wizard inherits it: the more panel scrolls to 角色立绘 / 工具 / 手动切换横竖屏 (previously only 5 of 7 rows were drawn), settings scrolls to the character section with the button row pinned, and the track menu reaches 删除当前音轨.
